extraction.Name: Lizzie Carson
extraction.Refused/Protested: did not want her patent in fee to her 320 acre allotment when it was sent to her by mail; but the Indian Agency told her it would be taxed, and sold for taxes, if she did not accept the patent, so she took it
extraction.Sold/Mortgaged: sold it, not remembering the man's name she sold it through; that she received $1000.00 cash for it; and that she thinks she got a very poor price for it
extraction.Occupation/Income: supported by her mother and step-father, the latter receiving a pension
extraction.NOTES: mentally incompetent; health is poor, has heart trouble; single; has never gotten any aid from the County, State nor the United States Government; sold land about 1923 for $1000.00 cash; affidavit sworn December 5, 1928
